statement: Moving an abstention from 'counted as 0' to 'left out of the composite' flips which way the degraded score can err: held at 0 it can never rise above the complete input, left out it rises whenever the complete input's criterion scores below the mean of the rest. On a shallow clone v27's A2 abstains; left out, a repository whose deleted secret only an earlier commit holds scored 2.0 against its full clone's 1.8, where A2 is critical. Rules: before turning a must-not-lower rule into left-out abstentions, enumerate fixtures whose complete-input finding lives only in the withheld input and measure the degraded composite against the complete one; state the must-not-raise half explicitly, and pin any rise you accept so a new one fails.
